node.title: KoalaBear active balanced-core bad-slope to component bridge
node.statement: For the deployed KoalaBear MCA row and frozen Grande Finale v4 first-match partition, every slope in the active Z_BC cell is assigned, on the same received line and without changing its witness support or affine slope, to an actual Q=6,s=6,u=2 endpoint record and one residual component. Existing decomposition routers then place it in exactly one of the live types (m,r,delta)=(2,4,2) or (2,8,1). The assignment is first-match exhaustive and disjoint and prints either an injection or exact finite fiber multiplicities from slopes to records/components. No parameter-line point is identified with an evaluation-carrier point.
node.falsifier: An active Z_BC slope with no actual component record, a component outside the two live types, two owners assigned to one slope, loss of support or affine-slope identity, or an unbounded/unprinted record multiplicity.
